Bundled Google Fonts
====================

Downloaded 2026-10-08 from the official Google Fonts CSS API and font CDN.
The font files are unmodified WOFF2 subsets. Both families are licensed
under SIL Open Font License 1.1; the full licenses are bundled alongside.

DM Sans: normal, variable weight 100–1000, Latin and Latin Extended.
Manrope: normal, variable weight 200–800, Latin and Latin Extended.
German characters (ÄÖÜäöüß) are included in the Latin subset.

CSS source:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@100..1000&family=Manrope:wght@200..800&display=swap

Official family sources:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmsans
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope

Downloaded files:
